name: Commerce Pricelist Schedule
description: Provides scheduled CSV import functionality for Commerce Pricelist: upload a price-list CSV, choose a start time, and cron runs the import (create/update price-list items, optionally deleting existing ones) via a queue worker. Admin-gated by the 'administer commerce_pricelist' permission.
project_description:
Commerce Pricelist Schedule adds scheduled import functionality to the Commerce Pricelist module. 

 Features 
 With this module you can schedule CSV file imports to run at a specified time.

 Usage 
 
 Navigate to the new "Scheduled Imports" tab at any pricelist page. 
 Click "Schedule Import" button and create a scheduled import in the same way as you would import a pricelist. 
 It is possible to cancel a scheduled import in needed.
